info.title: urtorrentd
info.description: HTTP API of urtorrentd, a BitTorrent daemon on the urtorrent library. Units: bytes, bytes per second, seconds, unix seconds; `null` means unknown or unlimited. Errors always have the `ErrorBody` shape with a stable `code`.

get.summary:
Live updates as server-sent events (`text/event-stream`). Every event is
named `sync`, its `id` is the revision and its `data` a `SyncResponse`:
the first is everything (or the changes since `rev`), the next ones only
what changed, at most once a second and only when something did. On
reconnect a browser's `EventSource` sends the last id as `Last-Event-ID`,
which resumes from there. Idle streams get a comment every 15 s.

parameters.name: rev
parameters.description:
Resume after this revision (a `Last-Event-ID` header wins); absent
starts with everything.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The last event id received (sent by `EventSource` on reconnect); wins over `rev`.

200.description: A stream of `sync` events; each `data` is a `SyncResponse`.

AddFailure.description: A source that could not be added.

hash.description: Info-hash, when it could be determined.

AddOptions.description: Options for new torrents. Absent fields use the settings' defaults.

save_path.description: Save directory (absolute). Ignored with automatic management.

download_path.description:
Download to this directory first, then move to the save path when
complete. Absent: the global `download_path` setting.

use_download_path.description: Use a download path at all (`false` downloads straight to the save path).

forced.description: Start regardless of the queue limits.

add_to_top_of_queue.description: Put at the front of the queue. Absent: the `add_to_top_of_queue` setting.

oneOf.description:
Stop automatically at this point. Absent: the `stop_condition`
setting.
Top-level folder layout. Absent: the `content_layout` setting.

upload_limit.description: Upload limit in bytes per second.

download_limit.description: Download limit in bytes per second.

max_uploads.description: Upload slot cap. Absent: the `max_uploads_per_torrent` setting.

auto_management.description:
Automatic management (save path from the category). Absent: the
`auto_management` setting.

first_last_piece_priority.description: Download the first and last pieces of each file first (previews).

file_priorities.description: File priorities in file order (0 = skip, 1..=7, higher first; 4 is normal).

preallocate.description: Allocate files at full size. Absent: the `preallocate` setting.

AddTorrentsRequest.description: Add torrents from URLs, magnet links, info-hashes and `.torrent` files.

urls.description: Magnet links, bare info-hashes, or `http(s)` URLs of `.torrent` files.

options.description: Options applied to every torrent in the request.

AddTorrentsResponse.description: The outcome of an add request.

tier.description: Tier; absent = a new tier after the last.

AfterAdd.description: What happens to a watched file once it is added.

AltSpeedRequest.description: Switch the alternative limits on or off.

AltSpeedSchedule.description:
When the alternative speed limits are on by themselves: from `from` to
`to` (local time) on the given days. A window that ends before it
starts runs past midnight and belongs to the day it starts on.

to.description: End, `HH:MM`; earlier than `from` = the next day.

days.description: The days a window starts on; empty (the default) = every day.

time_zone.description:
IANA time zone (`Europe/Berlin`); `null` (the default) = the
system's.

ApiKeyResponse.description: A new API key (shown once; only its hash is stored).

library.description: The torrent library and its version.

listen_port.description: The peer listen port in use.

restart_required.description: Settings changed since the start that apply only after a restart.

listen_addresses.description: The addresses listened on (and peers dialled from).

oneOf.description: The trackers fetched from `add_trackers_url`; `null` = none set.

AuthStatus.description: Whether the daemon still waits for its credentials.

setup_required.description:
No user name and password are set yet: the first
`POST /auth/setup` sets them.

peers.description: Addresses (`ip`, `ip:port` or `[ipv6]:port`; the port is ignored).

BulkFailure.description: One failure in a bulk action.

BulkResult.description: The outcome of a bulk action.

applied.description: Info-hashes the action was applied to.

save_path.description:
Save path for its automatically managed torrents: absolute, or relative
to the default save path; `null` = `<default save path>/<category name>`.

download_path.description:
Download path for its automatically managed torrents (absolute or
relative to the default download path); `null` = the global download path.

category.description: Category name (created if missing); `null` clears it.

ContentLayout.description: How the content's top-level folder is laid out.

Cookie.description:
A cookie sent with the daemon's own HTTP requests (`.torrent`
downloads, RSS feeds) to its domain (qBittorrent's `app/cookies`).

domain.description: The domain (`tracker.example`: that host and its subdomains).

path.description: Only for paths under this one (default `/`).

expires.description: When it expires, unix seconds; absent or `null` = never.

DownloadPathRequest.description: Move incomplete torrents' content to a download path (or back).

path.description:
The download path (absolute); `null` = none (the content goes to
the save path).

ErrorBody.description: Every error response has this body.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error codes. Clients branch on these, never on messages.

trackers.description: The trackers (added to new public torrents).

fetched.description: When they were fetched, unix seconds; `null` = not yet.

error.description: Why the last fetch failed; `null` = it did not.

index.description: Index (file order; padding files are not listed).

path.description: Path relative to the save path, `/`-separated.

availability.description: Fraction of the file's pieces that we or a connected peer have.

FileSearch.description: Files that match, by torrent name then file order.

built.description: When it was built, unix seconds; `null` = not loaded.

error.description:
Why it could not be read (at the start, or the last reload; a failed
reload keeps the database read before).

GeoDimension.description: What peer traffic is grouped by.

GeoPoint.description: Traffic with a place in one bucket.

peers.description:
Its peers that moved data in the bucket (distinct addresses per
torrent, summed over torrents).

GeoRow.description: Traffic with a place over a range.

as_org.description: The autonomous system's organization, as last seen.

downloaded.description: Payload bytes received from its peers.

uploaded.description: Payload bytes sent to its peers.

peers_max.description:
The most of its peers that moved data in one bucket (distinct
addresses per torrent, summed over torrents).

GeoStats.description:
Peer traffic by place. Rows plus `unattributed` add up to the torrents'
traffic in the range.

unattributed.description:
Traffic not tied to a peer: web seeds, and connections whose end
was missed. Peer traffic is sampled every 10 s, so the last seconds
of an ongoing transfer show here until the next sample.

located.description: A GeoIP database is loaded now.

GroupPoint.description: A group's traffic in one bucket.

GroupRow.description: A group's traffic over a range.

downloaded.description: Payload bytes downloaded by its torrents.

uploaded.description: Payload bytes uploaded by its torrents.

GroupStats.description:
Traffic by category or tag, by the membership each torrent has now (or
had when it was removed): changing a torrent's category moves its
history with it. With tags, a torrent counts in each of its tags.

Hashes.description: Which torrents a bulk action applies to: a list of info-hashes or `"all"`.

HashesRequest.description: A bulk action with no parameters.

Identity.description: The identity peers and trackers see (a urtorrent profile).

IdleSeed.description: A complete torrent and what it uploaded in the window.

uploaded.description: Payload bytes uploaded in the window.

value.description: `uploaded` / `size`: how many times over it was shared in the window.

seeding_time.description: Seconds it was seeding in the window.

last_upload.description: When it last uploaded, unix seconds; `null` = never.

added_on.description: When it was added, unix seconds.

tracker.description: Host of the tracker it works with.

IdleSeeds.description:
Complete torrents by what they uploaded in a window relative to their
size, least first: the candidates for removal come first.

from.description: The window's start (00:00 UTC, `days` days back), unix seconds.

recorded_from.description:
Recording covers the window from here (later than `from` when
statistics started within the window); `null` = nothing recorded.

LimitsRequest.description: Change per-torrent limits. Absent fields stay; `null` removes the limit.

upload_limit.description: Upload limit in bytes per second; `null` = unlimited.

download_limit.description: Download limit in bytes per second; `null` = unlimited.

max_connections.description: Peer connection cap; `null` = the global per-torrent default.

max_uploads.description: Upload slot cap; `null` = only the global budget.

LocationRequest.description: Move content to a new directory (turns automatic management off).

id.description: Increasing id; pass the last one seen as `after` to get newer entries.

ParseTorrentRequest.description: A `.torrent` to inspect without adding it.

PeerBreakdown.description:
Peer traffic broken down. Rows plus `unattributed` add up to the
torrents' traffic in the range (as in `GeoStats`).

unattributed.description: Traffic not tied to a peer (see `GeoStats`).

PeerDimension.description: What peer traffic is broken down by (besides place: `/stats/geo`).

progress.description: Fraction of the pieces it has.

country.description:
Its country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) from the GeoIP database; `null` =
no database, or not in it.

PeerLogEntry.description: One peer-log entry (an address banned or unbanned).

id.description: Increasing id; pass the last one seen as `after` to get newer entries.

banned.description: Whether the address is now banned (`false`: the ban was lifted).

PeerPoint.description: Peer traffic with one value in one bucket.

peers.description: Its peers that moved data in the bucket.

PeerRow.description: Peer traffic with one value over a range.

key.description:
The value (`qBittorrent`, `dht`, `utp`, ...); `null` = unknown (a
peer that sent no client name).

downloaded.description: Payload bytes received from its peers.

uploaded.description: Payload bytes sent to its peers.

peers_max.description:
The most of its peers that moved data in one bucket (distinct
addresses per torrent, summed over torrents).

enabled.description: In use for this torrent (off in the settings or for private torrents).

availability.description: Connected peers (and web seeds) with each piece, in piece order.

priorities.description: Download priority of each piece (0 = skipped, 1..=7), in piece order.

PreviewInfo.description:
A torrent's metadata, fetched without adding the torrent (qBittorrent's
`fetchMetadata`). Adding the same info-hash (`POST /torrents`, as a
magnet link or info-hash) uses it, with no second fetch.

name.description: The name (the magnet's `dn` until the metadata is here).

created.description: When it was asked for, unix seconds.

expires.description: When it is dropped unless read again, unix seconds.

source.description: A magnet link, an info-hash, or the http(s) URL of a `.torrent`.

QueueMoveTo.description: Where to move torrents in the queue.

RenameRequest.description: Rename a file or folder inside a torrent.

old_path.description: Current path relative to the save path.

new_path.description: New path relative to the save path.

id.description: Its id within the feed (the `guid`, else the link).

torrent_url.description: What would be added: a `.torrent` URL or a magnet link.

description.description: Description (HTML as the feed gives it, at most 16 KiB).

size.description: Content size, bytes, when the feed says.

RssArticleIds.description: Which articles of a feed: a list of ids or `"all"`.

name.description: A label given to it; `null` = its own title.

title.description: The title the feed gives itself.

folder.description: The folder it is in (`tv/anime`); `null` = the top.

last_refresh.description: When it was last refreshed, unix seconds; `null` = never.

error.description: Why the last refresh failed; `null` = it did not.

RssFeedPatch.description: A change to a feed: only the fields present change.

folder.description: The folder to put it in (created if missing).

refresh_interval.description: Seconds between refreshes (at least 60); absent = the setting.

RssFolderMove.description: Move (rename) a folder, with what is in it.

RssRule.description: An automatic download rule. See `docs/api.md` for how titles match.

must_contain.description: What a title must contain (wildcards, or a regular expression).

episode_filter.description: Seasons and episodes to take (`1x2;1x8-15;2x1-;`); empty = any.

smart_filter.description:
Take each episode once (repacks and propers once more with
`rss_download_repacks`).

ignore_days.description: After a match, take nothing for this many days; 0 = off.

add_options.description: How what it takes is added (as in `POST /torrents`).

last_match.description: When it last took something, unix seconds.

RssRuleRequest.description: A rule's definition (`PUT /rss/rules/{name}`); its history is kept.

must_contain.description: What a title must contain; empty = anything.

episode_filter.description: Seasons and episodes to take; empty = any.

ignore_days.description: After a match, take nothing for this many days.

add_options.description: How what it takes is added.

reset_history.description: Forget the episodes it took and when it last matched.

Settings.description: The daemon's settings. Every field is always present.

listen_port.description: TCP and UDP listen port for peers (0 = pick an ephemeral port at start).

random_port.description: Pick a new random listen port at every start.

listen_v4.description: IPv4 listen address; `null` turns IPv4 off (no socket, no IPv4 peers).

listen_v6.description: IPv6 listen address; `null` turns IPv6 off.

oneOf.description: The identity peers and trackers see.
Peer transports (TCP, uTP) and their order.

dht.description: The DHT (BEP 5). Private torrents never use it.

pex.description: Peer exchange (BEP 11). Private torrents never use it.

lsd.description: Local service discovery (BEP 14). Private torrents never use it.

dht_bootstrap_nodes.description:
DHT bootstrap routers (`host:port`); `null` = the identity's defaults.
Applies after a restart.

max_connections_per_torrent.description: Peer connections per torrent (the default for torrents without their own cap).

max_uploads_per_torrent.description: Upload slots per torrent for new torrents; `null` = only the global budget.

banned_ip_ranges.description:
Address ranges banned from every torrent: `10.0.0.0/8`, `fd00::/8`, or
`first-last` (`1.2.3.0-1.2.4.255`).

download_limit.description: Global download limit in bytes per second; `null` = unlimited.

upload_limit.description: Global upload limit in bytes per second; `null` = unlimited.

alt_download_limit.description: Alternative download limit (bytes per second) used while `alt_speed_enabled`.

alt_upload_limit.description: Alternative upload limit (bytes per second) used while `alt_speed_enabled`.

instance_name.description:
A name for this daemon that clients show (`GET /app`); `null` =
none.

listen_interface.description:
Listen on this network interface's addresses (`GET /app/interfaces`),
in the families `listen_v4` / `listen_v6` enable, and send
everything from them (peers, trackers, web seeds, DHT); followed as
they change. With no address (a VPN down) only loopback is used, so
nothing leaves through another interface.
`null` = the `listen_v4` / `listen_v6` addresses.

oneOf.description:
Turn the alternative limits on and off by the clock; `null` = only
by hand. At the window's start they go on, at its end off; a switch
by hand in between holds until the next boundary.

queueing_enabled.description: Limit how many torrents are active at once (the queue).

max_active_downloads.description: Active downloading torrents while queueing; `null` = unlimited.

max_active_uploads.description: Active seeding torrents while queueing; `null` = unlimited.

max_active_torrents.description: Active torrents in total while queueing; `null` = unlimited.

count_slow_torrents.description: Count torrents that move no data (below 2 KiB/s for 60 s) towards the queue limits.

save_path.description: Where new torrents are saved (absolute path).

download_path.description:
Where incomplete torrents are downloaded before moving to their save
path (absolute path); `null` = straight to the save path.

incomplete_file_suffix.description:
Appended to the name of every file that is not complete yet (e.g.
`.!qB`), removed when the file completes; `null` = off. Changing it
renames the files of every torrent.

add_to_top_of_queue.description: Put new torrents at the front of the queue.

oneOf.description: The content layout of new torrents whose add does not say.
The stop condition of new torrents whose add does not say.

category_paths_in_manual_mode.description:
A manually managed torrent added with a category and no save path
of its own goes to the category's save path.

excluded_file_names.description:
File names skipped when a torrent is added (wildcards `*` and `?`,
case ignored): a file whose name, or a folder on its path, matches
gets priority 0.

merge_trackers.description:
Adding a torrent that is there already merges the new trackers and
web seeds into it (never for private torrents, AGENTS.md rule 2).

recheck_on_completion.description:
Recheck a torrent when its download finishes (after the move to its
save path, if any).

export_dir.description:
Write the `.torrent` of every torrent added into this directory
(absolute); `null` = no.

export_dir_finished.description:
Write the `.torrent` of every finished torrent into this directory
(absolute); `null` = no.

add_trackers_url.description:
A list of trackers (one URL per line) fetched at the start and every
24 hours, added to new public torrents like `add_trackers`; `null` =
none. What was fetched is in `GET /app`.

watch_folders.description: Folders whose `.torrent` and `.magnet` files are added (at most 32).

rss_enabled.description:
Refresh the RSS feeds by themselves (a refresh asked for runs
either way).

rss_refresh_interval.description:
Seconds between refreshes of a feed without its own interval (at
least 60).

rss_fetch_delay.description: Seconds between two requests to the same host (at most 3600).

rss_max_articles.description: Articles kept per feed, the newest (1 to 5000).

rss_auto_download.description: Run the RSS download rules on new articles.

rss_download_repacks.description:
A rule's smart filter takes a REPACK or PROPER of an episode it
took once more.

preallocate.description: Allocate content files at full size when they are created.

auto_management.description: New torrents use automatic management (save path from their category).

add_trackers.description: Trackers added to every new public torrent (never to private ones).

max_ratio.description: Share ratio at which the share limit action runs; `null` = no limit.

max_seeding_time.description: Seeding time (seconds) at which the share limit action runs; `null` = no limit.

max_inactive_seeding_time.description:
Seconds of seeding without traffic after which the share limit action
runs; `null` = no limit.

oneOf.description: What happens when a share limit is reached.

hash_threads.description: SHA-1 hashing threads. Applies after a restart.

max_open_files.description: Content files kept open at once. Applies after a restart.

max_checking.description: Torrents checked at once. Applies after a restart.

piece_extent_affinity.description: Prefer finishing recently started 4 MiB extents. Applies after a restart.

max_concurrent_announces.description: Tracker requests in flight at once. Applies after a restart.

disk_thread.description: Run disk I/O on its own io_uring thread. Applies after a restart.

zero_copy_send.description: Zero-copy sends for piece payloads. Applies after a restart.

api_session_timeout.description: Idle seconds after which an API login session expires.

api_max_auth_failures.description: Failed logins from one address before it is banned.

api_ban_duration.description: Seconds an address stays banned after too many failed logins.

geoip_database.description:
A MaxMind DB file (`.mmdb`, absolute path) with countries:
GeoLite2-Country, DB-IP IP-to-Country Lite or IPinfo Lite; `null` =
none. Peers show their country and `/stats/geo` has traffic by
country. Re-read when the file changes; never downloaded.

geoip_asn_database.description:
A MaxMind DB file with autonomous systems (GeoLite2-ASN, DB-IP
IP-to-ASN Lite); `null` = none (IPinfo Lite has them in
`geoip_database`).

stats_enabled.description:
Record statistics (`/stats`): traffic per torrent and for the session,
each torrent's days, the timeline. Off: nothing new is recorded, what
was recorded stays.

stats_minute_retention.description: Seconds per-minute statistics are kept; `null` = forever.

stats_hour_retention.description: Seconds per-hour statistics are kept; `null` = forever.

stats_day_retention.description:
Seconds days, the timeline and recording periods are kept; `null` =
forever.

stats_scrape_interval.description:
Scrape every torrent's trackers this often (seconds, at least 1800)
for the swarm's completed downloads in `/stats/torrents/{hash}/days`;
`null` = never (the default: announces already report the swarm's
seeds and leechers).

api_auth_whitelist.description: Address blocks (`10.0.0.0/8`, `fd00::/8`) whose clients need no authentication.

api_trusted_proxies.description:
Reverse proxies (addresses or blocks, `10.0.0.0/8`) trusted to tell
the client's address (`X-Forwarded-For`) and host
(`X-Forwarded-Host`); empty = none.

api_allowed_hosts.description:
Host names accepted in the `Host` header (`*` = any, `*.example.com` =
subdomains). IP addresses are always accepted.

api_csrf_protection.description: Reject state-changing requests from browsers on other origins.

ShareLimitAction.description: What happens when a torrent reaches a share limit.

size.description: Size of the database file, bytes.

torrents.description: Torrents with history, removed ones included.

oldest_minute.description: Oldest per-minute bucket kept, unix seconds; `null` = none.

oldest_hour.description: Oldest per-hour bucket kept, unix seconds; `null` = none.

oldest_day.description: Oldest day kept, unix seconds; `null` = none.

StatsPeriod.description:
A period in which statistics were recorded: the daemon ran with
`stats_enabled` on. Outside every period nothing is known (the daemon was
down or recording was off); inside one, a missing bucket means nothing
moved.

ended.description: When it ended, unix seconds; `null` = still recording.

clean.description:
Ended by a shutdown or by turning recording off (`true` while still
recording). `false`: the daemon stopped abruptly and `ended` is its
last write (up to a minute early).

StatsStep.description:
The bucket size of a statistics series. Each bucket is named by its start
(`t`, unix seconds, aligned to UTC minutes, hours or days).

StopCondition.description: Stop a torrent automatically once it reaches a point.

SyncResponse.description:
Changes since a revision. With `full`, the maps hold everything and the
client replaces its state; otherwise they hold only what changed and the
`*_removed` lists say what went away. Torrents and categories are sent
whole whenever any field changed.

full.description: This is a full state, not a diff.

torrents.description: Torrents added or changed, by info-hash.

tags.description: The full tag list, when it changed (always with `full`).

TagsRequest.description: Change torrents' tags (missing tags are created).

TimelineEvent.description: An event of a torrent's life.

name.description: The torrent's name as last recorded.

detail.description: The new directory (`moved`) or the error (`error`).

ToggleRequest.description: A bulk action with an on/off value.

TopTorrent.description: A torrent's traffic over a range.

removed.description:
When the torrent was removed, unix seconds; `null` = still in the
session (or removed while recording was off).

downloaded.description: Payload bytes downloaded in the range.

uploaded.description: Payload bytes uploaded in the range.

TopTorrents.description: Torrents ranked by their traffic over a range (removed ones included).

step.description:
The buckets summed (the finest kept for the whole range); the range
is widened to whole buckets.

torrents.description: Highest first; torrents that moved nothing are left out.

TorrentDay.description:
One torrent's day (UTC): its seeding history. A day is recorded when the
torrent was running or moved data.

peers_max.description: Most peers connected at one observation (every 2 s).

seeds_max.description: Most seeds connected at one observation (every 2 s).

active_time.description: Seconds the torrent was running that day.

seeding_time.description: Seconds it was seeding that day.

downloaded_total.description: All-time bytes downloaded at the day's last observation.

uploaded_total.description: All-time bytes uploaded at the day's last observation.

active_time_total.description: All-time seconds running at the day's last observation.

seeding_time_total.description: All-time seconds seeding at the day's last observation.

ratio.description:
Share ratio at the day's last observation (as `ratio` in the torrent
list); `null` = nothing to divide by.

swarm_seeds_max.description: Most seeders the trackers reported for the swarm; `null` = no report.

swarm_leechers_max.description: Most leechers the trackers reported for the swarm; `null` = no report.

swarm_completed_max.description:
Most completed downloads a scrape reported for the swarm; `null` = no
scrape (they run only with `stats_scrape_interval`).

removed.description:
When the torrent was removed, unix seconds; `null` = still in the
session (or removed while recording was off).

known_peers.description: Peer addresses known (connected or waiting to be dialled).

source_url.description: The URL the torrent was added from.

TorrentErrorKind.description: What stopped a torrent in the `error` state, and so what brings it back.

files.description: Content files (padding files excluded), in file order.

TorrentPatch.description:
Change a torrent's display name or comment. Absent fields stay; `null`
restores the torrent's own value.

TorrentSort.description: Sort keys for the torrent list.

TorrentSummary.description: One row of the torrent list.

forced.description: Started regardless of the queue limits.

oneOf.description: What kind of error, in the `error` state.

downloaded.description: Payload bytes downloaded, all time (includes wasted bytes).

downloaded_session.description: Payload bytes downloaded since the daemon started.

uploaded_session.description: Payload bytes uploaded since the daemon started.

wasted.description: Bytes that failed hash checks or arrived redundantly.

ratio.description: Upload / download ratio; `null` when nothing counts as downloaded yet.

eta.description: Seconds until complete at the current rate; `null` when unknown.

max_uploads.description: Upload slot cap; `null` = only the global budget.

swarm_seeds.description: Seeds in the swarm as trackers report it.

swarm_leechers.description: Leechers in the swarm as trackers report it.

availability.description:
Distributed copies among the connected peers and us (libtorrent's
`distributed_copies`); `null` for a complete seed or before the
metadata.

download_path.description: Where the content lives until it is complete, if elsewhere.

content_path.description:
The content's path on disk (the file, or the top-level folder); `null`
before the metadata is known.

root_path.description: The top-level folder on disk; `null` for single files.

last_activity.description: Last time payload moved, unix seconds.

seen_complete.description: Last time a complete copy was seen, unix seconds.

seeding_time.description: Seconds running while complete, all time.

auto_management.description: Automatic management: the save path follows the category.

first_last_piece_priority.description: The first and last pieces of each wanted file come first.

piece_size.description: Piece length in bytes (0 before the metadata).

tracker.description: The tracker currently working; `null` if none is.

popularity.description: Ratio per month of active time; `null` when not computable.

next_announce_in.description: Seconds until the next tracker announce.

removed.description:
When the torrent was removed, unix seconds; `null` = still in the
session (or removed while recording was off).

points.description: Buckets in which data moved, oldest first.

periods.description: Recording periods overlapping the range, oldest first.

TrackerEndpointInfo.description: A tracker as announced through one listen socket.

local.description:
The local listen address announced from (unspecified when listening
on every address of the family).

working.description: The last announce through it succeeded.

updating.description: An announce through it is in flight.
An announce is in flight (any endpoint).

endpoints.description: The tracker per listen socket (it is announced once per socket).

TrackerRow.description: A tracker (by host) over a range.

host.description:
The tracker's host; `null` = torrents with no working tracker
(DHT only, or every tracker failing).

downloaded.description: Payload bytes downloaded by the torrents working with it.

uploaded.description:
Payload bytes uploaded by the torrents working with it (what a
private tracker credits, less what it does not see).

torrents.description: Torrents working with it that moved data.

TrackerStats.description:
Per tracker: the traffic of the torrents that work with it (the one each
torrent last worked with), and how its announces went. Only hosts are
kept: private trackers' URLs carry passkeys.

TrackersResponse.description: A torrent's trackers and trackerless peer sources.

TrafficPoint.description:
One torrent's traffic in one bucket. Buckets in which nothing moved are
left out.

downloaded.description: Payload bytes downloaded in the bucket.

uploaded.description: Payload bytes uploaded in the bucket.

peers_max.description: Most peers connected at one observation (every 2 s).

seeds_max.description: Most seeds connected at one observation (every 2 s).

downloaded_session.description: Payload bytes since the daemon started.

uploaded_session.description: Payload bytes since the daemon started.

ratio.description: All-time upload / download ratio; `null` before any download.

download_limit.description: Global download limit in force, bytes per second; `null` = unlimited.

upload_limit.description: Global upload limit in force, bytes per second; `null` = unlimited.

alt_speed_enabled.description: The alternative limits are in force.

listen_port.description: The peer listen port in use.

connections.description: Peer connections, including dials in progress.

dht_nodes.description: Nodes in the DHT routing table.

external_v4.description: External IPv4 address as peers and trackers see it.

external_v6.description: External IPv6 address as peers and trackers see it.

free_space.description: Free bytes on the default save path's file system.

TransferPoint.description:
Session-wide traffic in one bucket. Bytes are payload, as in
`TransferInfo`.

peers_max.description: Most peers connected at one observation (every 2 s).

connections_max.description: Most connections (peers plus dials in progress) at one observation.

dht_nodes_max.description: Most DHT nodes known at one observation.

torrents_max.description: Most torrents in the session at one observation.

points.description: Buckets in which the session was recorded, oldest first.

periods.description: Recording periods overlapping the range, oldest first.

WatchFolder.description:
A folder whose `.torrent` and `.magnet` files (a magnet link inside) are
added. A file is taken once it has not changed for 3 seconds; one that
cannot be added is renamed to `<name>.rejected` and the reason logged.

recursive.description:
Look in subfolders too (up to 8 levels; symbolic links to folders
are not followed).

options.description: How its torrents are added (as in `POST /torrents`).

after_add.description: What happens to a file once added.

events.description: The events it gets; empty = all.

deliveries.description: Its last deliveries (since the start, at most 20), newest first.

time.description: When it was first tried, unix seconds.

status.description: The last HTTP status; `null` = no answer.

error.description: What went wrong on the last try; `null` = delivered (2xx).

attempts.description:
Tries made (at most 4: at once, then after 2 s, 10 s and 60 s; only
no answer, 429 and 5xx are retried).

WebhookEvent.description: What a webhook is told about.

WebhookPatch.description: A change to a webhook: only the fields present change.

events.description: The events it gets; empty = all.

WebhookPayload.description:
What a webhook receives: `POST` with this JSON body and the headers
`X-Urtorrentd-Event`, `X-Urtorrentd-Delivery`, `X-Urtorrentd-Timestamp`
and, with a secret, `X-Urtorrentd-Signature: sha256=<hex>`: the
HMAC-SHA256 of `<timestamp>.<body>` with the secret.

delivery.description: This delivery's id (the same on every retry).

oneOf.description:
The torrent as the list shows it (for `removed`, just before);
`null` for `test`, or if it could not be read.

detail.description: The new directory (`moved`) or the error (`error`).

url.description: Where to POST the events (http or https).

events.description: The events it gets; empty (the default) = all.

secret.description: Signs each delivery (`X-Urtorrentd-Signature`); never shown again.
